name: 0.1.0-beta.9
notes:
# Folian Beta 9

This release makes the Workspace feel safer and more useful when returning to an existing writing project.

- Existing projects now appear first when Folian opens.
- The most recently used project is highlighted under Continue writing.
- Other projects appear in a clearer Recent projects section.
- New-project setup stays collapsed until you choose to create another project.
- About Folian now provides a clearer Beta 9 version reference.
- Existing local projects, API keys, exports and backups remain separate from application updates.

Folian Beta 9 will also be used to validate the complete desktop update path from Beta 8.
